AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why do farmers and cleaners wear personal protective equipment? (1 mark)
   A. To keep food hot
   B. To make work slower
   C. To protect the body from dirt, injury and germs
   D. To look tall

2. Why do we sweep before mopping? (1 mark)
   A. Because mops cannot touch water
   B. To remove loose dirt so it does not turn to mud
   C. To use more soap
   D. To waste time

3. Which nutrient do oranges and guavas supply in large amounts? (1 mark)
   A. Vitamin C
   B. Salt
   C. Starch
   D. Cooking oil

4. Which group does githeri belong to mainly? (1 mark)
   A. Energy and body-building
   B. Drinks
   C. Only water
   D. Only protective

5. Where should the graft joint of a grafted seedling be? (1 mark)
   A. In water
   B. Above the ground
   C. In the compost
   D. Deep below the soil

6. Who should be called when a cow is sick? (1 mark)
   A. A veterinary officer
   B. A carpenter
   C. A tailor
   D. A driver

7. What is the first thing to do with leftover cooked food? (1 mark)
   A. Leave it in the sun
   B. Leave it on the floor
   C. Throw it in the road
   D. Cover it and store it safely

8. What is a seedling? (1 mark)
   A. A dry stick
   B. A type of soil
   C. A ripe fruit
   D. A young plant grown from a seed

9. Why is it a good idea to use the water from boiled vegetables in soup? (1 mark)
   A. It is poisonous
   B. It has no use
   C. It is dirty
   D. It contains vitamins that came out of the vegetables

10. Which crop can be harvested about four to six weeks after sowing? (1 mark)
   A. Mango
   B. Banana
   C. Radish
   D. Millet

11. What is the use of a hygiene log? (1 mark)
   A. Counting money
   B. Recording daily hygiene practices
   C. Listing games
   D. Measuring rain

12. What should you use to wash your hands? (1 mark)
   A. Soap and clean water
   B. Only dry cloth
   C. Mud
   D. Dirty water

13. Why should tiny seeds not be sown deeply? (1 mark)
   A. They run out of stored food before reaching the light
   B. They wash away
   C. They become large
   D. They grow faster

14. Why stuff canvas shoes with paper after washing? (1 mark)
   A. It makes them dirty
   B. It keeps their shape and soaks up moisture
   C. It makes them wet
   D. It makes them heavier

15. Why should hands be washed after handling chickens? (1 mark)
   A. To colour the hands
   B. To warm the hands
   C. To remove germs
   D. To get feathers off

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Name the young of a cow, a goat and a sheep. (3 marks)

17. State the functions of roots, leaves and flowers in a fruit tree. (3 marks)

18. Name three products we get from cattle. (3 marks)

19. Give two reasons why goats are suitable for dry areas. (2 marks)

20. Name two other ways of saving water in the garden. (2 marks)

21. Give two disadvantages of shallow frying. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
AGRICULTURE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — To protect the body from dirt, injury and germs
   PPE is clothing and gear that protects us from harm.

2. B — To remove loose dirt so it does not turn to mud
   Mopping dirt makes mud.

3. A — Vitamin C
   Citrus fruits and guavas are rich in vitamin C.

4. A — Energy and body-building
   Maize gives energy, beans give protein.

5. B — Above the ground
   Buried joints can rot or grow roots of the wrong kind.

6. A — A veterinary officer
   A vet treats sick animals.

7. D — Cover it and store it safely
   Covered food stays safe from flies.

8. D — A young plant grown from a seed
   A seedling is a young plant.

9. D — It contains vitamins that came out of the vegetables
   Some vitamins go into the cooking water.

10. C — Radish
   Radish grows very quickly.

11. B — Recording daily hygiene practices
   A log helps to form habits.

12. A — Soap and clean water
   Soap removes germs.

13. A — They run out of stored food before reaching the light
   Deep seeds cannot push up to the surface.

14. B — It keeps their shape and soaks up moisture
   Paper absorbs water.

15. C — To remove germs
   Poultry can carry germs.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Calf, kid and lamb.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct name.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: Roots hold the tree and take in water; leaves make food using sunlight; flowers form fruits.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each part.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Milk, beef, hides and skins, manure, or draught power (any three).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each product.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: They eat leaves, shrubs and grass, and can live where cattle find little to eat.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Mulching, collecting rainwater, watering in the morning or evening, reusing wash water (any two).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: It can splash and burn, and too much oil is not good for health.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each disadvantage.
